name: Eindhoven hardware engineer seeking a reduced workweek

context.geography: Netherlands; Eindhoven area or feasible EU remote role
constraints: Four days and approximately 32 hours, not compressed 40 hours
Hardware lab presence may limit remote options
context.company_awareness: Knows semiconductor and hardware firms; wants to follow suitable roles

trigger: The engineer decides that the next move must reduce weekly hours, then finds four-day claims and 32–40-hour ranges that need closer interpretation.

searches_run.query: hardware engineer semiconductor Eindhoven jobs 32 hours English
searches_run.observation: Results included engineering recruiters, campus postings and adjacent electrical work with weekly-hour ranges. English queries also returned Dutch pages; neither language sufficiency nor direct product-company employment was established by the title.

searches_run.query: electronics engineer Netherlands four day week 32 hours not compressed
searches_run.observation: A specialist four-day directory and broad discussions appeared alongside engineering vacancies. The inspected campus advert states 32–40 hours, but does not specify four working days or remote eligibility.

sources.title: Test- & Service engineer — High Tech Campus Eindhoven / VEDS
sources.supports: Direct campus-posting inspection states 32–40 hours and hardware test/service duties at a design partner. It does not establish a four-day pattern, an exclusively owned-product business or remote work.

sources.title: Firmware Engineer Eindhoven — Evoke
sources.supports: Retrieved staffing page labels semiconductor work at 32–40 hours. Staffing employment is distinct from direct employment by the named product ecosystem.

sources.title: Four-day-week companies in the Netherlands — 4dayweek.io
sources.supports: Retrieved specialist directory distinguishes 32-hour policies and 80% variants and includes hardware design-house QBayLogic. Company policies and vacancies were not independently verified.

best_entry_page.promise: Find hardware roles with published weekly-hour options and compare days, workplace requirements and employer type before following companies.
best_entry_page.cta: Select covered hardware employers and save role searches; inspect 32-hour wording in descriptions.
proof_needed: Separate reduced weekly hours, compressed hours and unspecified four-day language.
A 32–40 range is an option to clarify, not a guaranteed 32-hour offer.
Do not equate part-time with reduced pay or four-day with full pay; report stated terms only.
Separate remote design work from physical lab/testing duties and country restrictions.
Create a new indexable guide; filtered results remain noindex.

conversion_objections: Does a 32–40 range apply to this particular team?
Am I joining the product company or a staffing firm?
How often must I be in the lab?
Does an English posting mean English is sufficient?
Can I follow known firms even when no reduced-hours role is open?

avoid_targeting.reason: Hardware work may require physical facilities; no universal remote promise.

avoid_targeting.query: four day full salary hardware guaranteed
avoid_targeting.reason: Hours, pay and acceptance vary by role.
Legal rights are outside this product-research scope.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I am happy to come to the lab, but I want fewer weekly hours, not forty squeezed into four days. Let me follow the companies I know and show the exact hours and on-site expectations when a relevant opening appears.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic English-speaking engineer. Two queries and one campus-page inspection; no working-time law, language eligibility or company-policy verification. Exact hardware specialism, desired pay arrangement and permissible commute are unspecified.
